s05-rugpull-pin: Blocks any call to any tool when the tool's description or schema has changed since it was approved.
u10-engineers-pr-review: Lets people in the engineers group make calls (attended or unattended) to the github.read_pr and github.post_review_comment tools.
u11-engineers-research: Lets people in the engineers group make calls (attended or unattended) to the kb.search and cloudwatch.query_logs tools.
u12-governance-review: Lets people in the governance-reviewers group make calls (attended or unattended) to the github.read_pr, github.post_review_comment, kb.search and confluence.update_requirement tools.
u13-analysts-backlog: Lets people in the business-analysts group make calls (attended or unattended) to the backlog.create_story_draft, backlog.update_story, confluence.update_requirement and kb.search tools.
u14-compliance-evidence: Lets people in the compliance group make calls (attended or unattended) to the github.read_pr, kb.search and cloudwatch.query_logs tools.
u20-never-merge-or-approve-pr: Blocks calls (attended or unattended) to the github.merge_pr and github.approve_pr tools.
u21-never-change-policy: Blocks calls (attended or unattended) to the policy.change tool.
u22-never-deploy: Blocks calls (attended or unattended) to any tool when the tool name starts with “deploy.”.
u30-hold-story-update: Holds calls (attended or unattended) to the backlog.update_story tool, until Priya approves. It stops applying once someone has approved the call.
u31-hold-requirement-update: Holds calls (attended or unattended) to the confluence.update_requirement tool, until Priya approves. It stops applying once someone has approved the call.
u40-repo-scope-engineers: Blocks calls (attended or unattended) from people in the engineers group to any tool when the call names a repository, unless the repository is one of grid-ops-portal, outage-notifier.
u41-restricted-evidence-compliance-only: Blocks calls (attended or unattended) to any tool when the data is classified restricted, unless the person is in the compliance group.
